snippet.title: Tokimeki Memorial ~ Forever With You Opening
snippet.description:
This is the opening sequence for a Playstation Dating Simulation Game called "Tokimeki Memorial ~ Forever With You."

One of Japan's most popular dating sims, Tokimeki Memorial, was first released in 1994 for the PC Engine. Over the years, its overwhelming popularity has led to various remakes and spin-offs. Overall, it is known as the Dating Sim that Started It All.

In Tokimeki Memorial, male players make their way through three years of high school, while trying to attract a female character from a pool of dateable characters. The game play focuses mainly on scheduling, dating, and stat-building. If the player is successful at wooing a female character by the end of the third year, then he will receive a confession of love at the famous Tree of Legend along with that character's special ending.

Music:
"Motto! Motto! Tokimeki" by Mami Kingetsu

For Tokimeki Memorial images, music, and more, visit our website at http://www.tokimekimedia.net
